clue.text: Strip when hot to turn into a relative

indicators.note: into says the turned letters go inside the relative's word

parts.note: an uncle is a relative

indicators.note: to turn tells us the three letters of hot are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone gets so warm they start peeling off garments, almost turning into a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn' rearranges HOT to OTH, and 'into' puts that inside UNCLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To strip someone is to take their garments off, synonym sense.

clue.text: Misleading, but not in the House?

definitions.meaning: deceived, so the phrase describes misleading talk
playfully, someone on the walk from gate to door is outdoors, not inside the building

explanation.definitionFit: To lead someone up the garden path is to deceive them, and a garden walk is literally outside one's home.

clue.text: Town is for sailors, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word for sailors is to be said aloud, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: a ship's crew is its sailors

explanation.surface: A town is said to be meant for seafarers.
explanation.walkthrough: CREWE is a railway town in Cheshire, England, pronounced just like CREW.
explanation.definitionFit: Crewe is a Cheshire railway town, an example of the category.

clue.text: Upset a vessel in public

parts.note: overt means open, in public view
an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: Someone knocks over a container in full view of everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: To upset something is to knock it over, a synonym.

clue.text: Lots of cards provided for workers

definitions.meaning: sets of playing cards dealt to each player
farm or factory labourers are called ...

explanation.definitionFit: Card sets dealt to players and manual labourers share the same plural noun, two separate senses.

clue.text: Repressed writer pursued by ram

indicators.note: pursued by puts the ram's word after the writer's word

parts.note: a pen is a writing implement, a writer
tup is a dialect word for a ram

explanation.surface: An author is being chased by an angry male sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: Repressed feelings are bottled up, held in, a synonym.

clue.text: Time of year when glutton loses his head

indicators.note: losing his head means the glutton's word drops its opening letter

parts.note: a feaster is someone who eats greedily

explanation.surface: A season when an overeater goes completely mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses his head' sounds like panic, but it removes the F of FEASTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Easter is a festival season in spring, an example.

clue.text: Used in warfare but caught there in disarray

indicators.note: in disarray means the letters are thrown into confusion and rearranged

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Something used in battle, but captured where it lay in chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: A trebuchet is a medieval siege engine, a giant sling for hurling stones; 'Used in warfare' is a descriptive definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval catapult was a weapon employed in sieges, described by its use.

clue.text: Newspaper contributions for stylites?

parts.note: stylites were ascetics who lived atop pillars, so their own pillars would be private ads sections of a newspaper

explanation.definitionFit: Newspaper sections of private small ads, punningly the pillars belonging to pillar-dwelling saints.

clue.text: Protection needed by selector when the series is lost

indicators.note: when the series, the sequence, is lost the letters fall out of order and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A team selector needs some armour when the side loses the series.
explanation.walkthrough: 'series' suggests sport, but losing the order of the letters of SELECTOR is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A corselet is a piece of body armour, a kind of protection.

clue.text: The controller to go into that place

parts.note: a rein controls a horse

explanation.surface: The manager has to enter a particular spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Thereinto is an old adverb for into that place or thing, a direct gloss.

clue.text: Vertical deviation

definitions.meaning: a precipitous cliff face is perpendicular
a ship's swerve from its course

explanation.definitionFit: A perpendicular drop and a ship's swerve both take this word, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Occurrence featured in the seven times table

indicators.note: featured in says the letters appear within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Something that crops up in the multiplication tables for seven.
explanation.definitionFit: An event is a happening, a synonym.

clue.text: Prolonged notes to us need decyphering

indicators.note: decyphering means working out a code, so the letters must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Musical notes sent to us require decoding.
explanation.walkthrough: SOSTENUTO is a musical direction meaning sustained; the 'notes' surface fits.
explanation.definitionFit: Sostenuto is a musical term for sustained playing, synonym of drawn out.

clue.text: A story about a way across is not too expensive

indicators.note: about means the story's word wraps round the crossing

parts.note: a fable is a story
a ford is a shallow place to cross a river

explanation.surface: A tale about a crossing point that is reasonably priced.
explanation.definitionFit: Affordable means within one's budget, synonym of cheap enough.

clue.text: It takes a punctilious person to compile a catalogue

parts.note: to form is to put together, compile
a list is a catalogue

explanation.surface: Only a fussy, precise person could draw up a full inventory.
explanation.definitionFit: A formalist sticks rigidly to rules and forms, a stickler.

clue.text: Means of, making rapid progress in radio technique

parts.note: on air means broadcasting on radio
craft is skill or technique

explanation.surface: Broadcasting skill lets someone get ahead fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Planes are a means of fast travel, a descriptive definition.

clue.text: Stop an article on the question of personality

indicators.note: in an across answer on puts the article after the other piece

parts.note: who is the question asking which person
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Halt an essay dealing with identity.
explanation.definitionFit: Whoa is the command to halt, used to stop a horse.

clue.text: Put in a fellow when cut off

indicators.note: in places the first word inside the fellow's word

parts.note: a mate is a fellow, a companion

explanation.surface: Bring in a partner once someone has been severed from the group.
explanation.definitionFit: To amputate is to sever a limb, synonym.

clue.text: Rage after penny dreadful

indicators.note: after puts the rage word behind the penny

parts.note: D is the old abbreviation for a penny, from the Latin denarius
ire is anger, rage

explanation.surface: Fury after a cheap sensational paperback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'penny dreadful' looks like one phrase, a cheap Victorian thriller, but it splits: 'penny' gives D and 'dreadful' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Dire means terrible, a synonym.

clue.text: Science of skill without one going to hospital with an alien

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so skill surrounds one

parts.note: art is skill
I is the Roman numeral one
H is the map abbreviation for hospital
a metic was a resident foreigner in an ancient Greek city

explanation.surface: Some science of skill with nobody admitted to hospital alongside a foreigner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside: ART goes round I. METIC, an alien resident in ancient Athens, is an uncommon word.
explanation.definitionFit: Arithmetic is the branch of mathematics dealing with numbers, an example of a science.

clue.text: Cheats are reformed to become virtuous

indicators.note: reformed means formed again, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Cheats turn over a new leaf to become good.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaste means pure, morally good, a synonym.

clue.text: They look after animals but cause heartbreak among donkeys

indicators.note: among puts the broken letters inside the donkeys' word

parts.note: neddy or ned is a familiar word for a donkey

indicators.note: break shatters the letters of heart into a new order

explanation.surface: Animal carers who bring sorrow to donkeys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartbreak' splits: 'break' rearranges HEART to ATHER, inside NEDS. Neat is an old word for cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatherds are cowherds, people tending cattle.

clue.text: River party

definitions.meaning: a bout of revelry or spending

explanation.definitionFit: A German waterway through Berlin and a binge of fun share the same name.

clue.text: Up to the time of being in a punt I laze on the shore

indicators.note: in says the letters sit within the next words

explanation.surface: Lounging in a boat by the bank until it's time to go.
explanation.definitionFit: Until means up to a point in time, a synonym.

clue.text: No longer seen in London, they are the reverse of fashionable

indicators.note: the reverse of tells us to read the fashionable word backwards

parts.note: smart means stylish, fashionable

explanation.surface: Vehicles vanished from the capital's streets as hopelessly unstylish.
explanation.walkthrough: London's old tram network closed in 1952; the clue predates their return in Croydon in 2000.
explanation.definitionFit: Streetcars had vanished from the capital when this was set, a descriptive definition.

clue.text: Group of stars which need a girl to make records

indicators.note: the stars need a girl added to make records, so the girl is taken out of the records' word

parts.note: diaries are daily records
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

explanation.surface: A constellation that needs a young woman to cut some discs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'records' suggests discs; it is DIARIES, and adding DI to the answer makes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Aries is the constellation of the Ram, an example of a star group.

clue.text: Warning of disaster given by genuine adult entering business

indicators.note: entering puts the genuine adult inside the business word

parts.note: a firm is a business
real means genuine
A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: A real grown-up arrives at the office to warn of catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: A siren signalling flames is a warning of danger, descriptive.

clue.text: Emotion which gives colour to something on the head

parts.note: a hat is worn on the head
red is a colour

explanation.surface: A feeling that tints one's headgear.
explanation.definitionFit: Hatred is intense dislike, an example of a feeling.

clue.text: Setbacks on lines

parts.note: re means about, on the subject of
verses are lines of poetry

explanation.surface: Disappointments concerning a poem.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverses are reversals of fortune, defeats, synonym.
